description:
Just formed an LLC in New York? Find out the publication requirement, how much it costs to publish by county, and which newspapers you need — before the 120-day deadline. Live pricing for all 62 NY counties. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs, and PLLCs.

What you can do:
- Check if your LLC needs to publish and what happens if you don't
- Get county-specific pricing and designated newspaper lists
- Generate a legally compliant publication notice
- Verify an existing notice for compliance issues
- Review your filing package before mailing to the state
- Get step-by-step guidance for the full process

 Data sourced from NY LLC Law §206, county clerk offices, and llcpublishers.com — updated regularly.
